title: Show me your nickname
description: A mod that allows you to see the nickname of a player you're looking at from a distance.
body:
"Show me your nickname" displays the nickname of the player you're looking at when you right-click. The maximum range is 512 blocks.

To control the mod, use the following commands:

Enable - /playertarget on\
Disable - /playertarget off\
Change status - /playertarget toggle
